run_f_gold: run f_gold(n) to count the number of ways to build a street given constraints using dynamic programming
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled by running the main block with multiple input parameters
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which uses a 2-row DP table to compute ways to build a street
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to reduce space complexity from O(n) to O(1) by tracking only the previous state
review_f_gold: review the f_gold dynamic programming solution for counting ways to build a street with given constraints
